name: Sizer Box Squeeze
hook: Cram that swollen duffel into the metal bin before the gate agent notices
tagline: The metal luggage frame groans under the impossible volume of an overstuffed weekender bag filled with bubble wrap and trinkets. Cash out to slide the bag in with a satisfying click and print boarding pass group 1. Crash and the zipper ruptures with acoustic fury, scattering tacky fridge magnets across gate 14.
